task_description: Add a sky-map astronomy chatbot to Celestia: a backend that deterministically computes a constellation's real-time visibility (altitude, azimuth/compass, next rise time, four-state classifier) for the map's current lat/lon/time and has an LLM phrase the facts, exposed at POST /skymap/chat; plus a frontend chat panel on the sky-map page threading the in-use lat/lon (real GPS or Bucharest 44.4/26.1 fallback) and current time. Realizes .agents/tasks/skymap-chatbot/design.md. Only ADD; no rendering changes; no commit/push; do not touch application.properties or mvnw.
